channel.title: Toronto Star – Adam Radwanski
channel.description: Articles by Adam Radwanski from the Toronto Star.

item.title: Adam Radwanski: Canada’s EU ambassador reveals what we really stand to gain from a partnership with Europe
item.description: Ambassador Jonathan Wilkinson says closer EU ties won't cost Canada its independence, but will build shared resilience against global upheaval.

item.title: Adam Radwanski: Mark Carney’s sweeping new bill gets one big thing right
item.description: Mark Carney’s plan to end Canada's five-year project approval delays is promising, writes Adam Radwanski, but cluttered by political noise.

item.title: Adam Radwanski: Corporate Canada’s love-in with Mark Carney is like nothing we’ve seen before
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney’s cozy relationship with corporate Canada may drive investment, but faces potential backlash if political moods shift,

item.title: Adam Radwanski: Mark Carney’s airport privatization pitch was a misstep, at an otherwise successful summit
item.description: Making the airport privatization announcement at his signature gathering distracted from the main message of the summit, argues Adam Radwanski.

item.title: Adam Radwanski: Mark Carney’s foreign investment summit is like speed dating. The risks are real, but the opportunities could change Canada
item.description: The Toronto summit kicks off Monday with at least 167 project opportunities and a $1-trillion capital goal.

item.title: Carney’s $1-trillion investment summit to feature pipelines, nuclear build-outs and data centres, but no airports — for now
item.description: A document obtained by the Star offers a window into the aims of the much-hyped summit taking place in Toronto next week.

item.title: Adam Radwanski: Canada’s economy is strong enough to survive Donald Trump — but there could be real pain in Ontario
